topic: The Year 2038 problem: some computers will think it's 1901

claims.claim: Many computer systems (Unix time) count time as seconds since 00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970.
Systems that store this count as a signed 32-bit integer can hold at most 2,147,483,647 seconds, reached at 03:14:07 UTC on 19 January 2038.
One second later the value overflows to a negative number, which these systems read as 13 December 1901.
Only systems still using 32-bit signed time are affected; most modern systems use 64-bit time.
claims.note: Script says 'some computers' / 'older ones', never 'all computers'.

claims.claim: A signed 64-bit count of seconds lasts about 292 billion years.
